claims.statement: DEP01-A mean after PM is 514.705 compared with 501.727 before PM, with LOT-1235 at 515.49 and LOT-1239 at 513.92 after last PM at 68.75
Lots from CLN01 on other chambers are normal for example LOT-1238 at 503.85 on DEP02-B, while DEP01-A lots LOT-1235 at 515.49 and LOT-1239 at 513.92 are high
FDC shows no heater shift with recent mean 399.81 against baseline 399.97 with z-score -0.7, while recent measured wafers LOT-1235 at 515.49 and LOT-1239 at 513.92 remain high
Alarm lot LOT-1239 measured 513.92 outside control limits 493.0 to 507.0 with spec limits 485.0 to 515.0
DEP step stands out with DEP01-A at 507.12 compared with DEP01-B at 502.65 and DEP02-B at 502.07 and DEP02-A at 497.81 with anova p-value 0.0438

disposition.summary: DEP01-A came back from PM running thick with two consecutive high lots. Upstream and sensors look normal, so the chamber is off-target. Hold the alarm lot and the chamber for correction.

Deposition rate is lower for the first 10 to 25 wafers after a chamber clean.
sources.practitioner: Chambers are conditioned and recalibrated after PM, so a shift that survives into production points at the chamber. Engineers check per-tool box plots and time series around the PM.
